    real_inner_self_pos.mpr (show toL2 ℝ (f a) ≠ 0 from fun h => ha (congrArg (fromL2 ℝ) h))

  have hz := hg _ ht
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hz
